verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party AI integrations in both its Python and JavaScript SDKs. Supported AI libraries are auto-instrumented when installed, and as of JS SDK 11.0.0 the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks are instrumented out of the box, with per-integration options such as include_prompts and recordInputs/recordOutputs. missing for 10: no explicit naming in the evidence of LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK as supported integrations, no supported-library list, no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box — you don't need to add their integrations yourself.
You can also set `recordInputs` / `recordOutputs` on a specific AI integration.
